findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In _find_plugin_source (installer.py), remove the 'plugin_dir / "build" / "Release" / filename' candidate from the candidates list so the source is never found and the file is not deployed, causing the SHA-256 equality assertion to fail (target would not exist).

In _find_plugin_source (installer.py), remove the 'plugin_dir / f"build_{arch}" / "plugins" / filename' candidate so the source is never found and no file is copied, causing the deployed file existence and SHA-256 assertions to fail.

In _find_plugin_source (installer.py), remove the 'plugin_dir / f"build_{arch}" / "Release" / filename' candidate so the source binary in build_x32/Release/ is never found and the target is never created, causing the existence and SHA-256 assertions to fail.

notes: All three findings were weak-existence tests that only asserted deploy_x64dbg_plugin() returned True without verifying the deployed artifact. Each was hardened by adding a call to the existing _assert_deployed_pe helper which verifies file presence, byte-identical SHA-256 against the source, and the correct IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE field via pefile. The production code is correct; no defects were found.
